title: Meroe
summary: Raleigh names Meroe in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Meroe, a daughter of Cyrus the Great, whom her brother Cambyses married, with Atossa. She is not the citie. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter III, §. VIII, sig. 401b
